chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Retain your hair for the Hajj when you see the crescent of Dhu al-Qadah, and for the Umrah for a month.

key_terms.ذِي الْقَعْدَةِ: Dhu al-Qadah (the 11th month of the Islamic calendar)

ai.seo_question: When should a Muslim start retaining their hair before performing Hajj or Umrah?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi specifies the precise timing for the *muhrim* to begin retaining hair and nails, marking the start of the ritual state for Hajj upon sighting the Dhu al-Qadah crescent and for Umrah one month prior. This practice serves as a physical manifestation of *Ihram*, preparing the pilgrim’s body and spirit for the sacred rites by gradually separating them from worldly grooming habits. It underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the sanctity of time and physical preparation in fulfilling the pillars of pilgrimage.
